outfit.name: 原宿燕麦绞花露肩毛衣与绑带围裙
outfit.prose: An oversized chunky cream cable-knit sweater sliding off one shoulder, layered over a fitted black ribbed tube top and micro pleated skirt, styled with a delicate pink floral linen apron. Finished with sheer thighhighs and a slim leather thigh strap cinching the upper leg with subtle indentation.
